paite: Huai khit in hichi ahong hi a, Absalom in kangtalai leh sakolte leh mi sawmnga ama a tai ding in abawlkhol hi.
heading: Absalom Hel Sawmna
english: After this, Absalom prepared a chariot and horses for himself, and fifty men to run before him.

paite: Absalom zingkhang in athou a, kulh kongkhak lampi nawl ah ana dingh hi. Thubuai khensak dia kumpipa kiang a hong pai peuhmah ana sam a, "Nang koi khopi a kipan na hia?" ana chi zel hi. Amau, "Na sikha Israel namte lak a khat ka hi,” achi zel uh.
english: Absalom rose up early, and stood beside the way of the gate. When any man had a suit which should come to the king for judgment, then Absalom called to him, and said, “What city are you from?” He said, “Your servant is of one of the tribes of Israel.”

paite: Absalom in, "I aw, na thu ahoih in adik hi. Himahleh angaikhe ding mi kumpipa'n kuamah asep kei," ana chi zel hi.
english: Absalom said to him, “Behold, your matters are good and right; but there is no man deputized by the king to hear you.”

paite: Absalom mah in, "Michih thubuai gen ding nei hiam, nget ding nei hiam peuhmah ka kiang a ahong paina ding un, gam vaihawmpa in bawl in om leng chi na tel ing e aw! Huchi in diktak in vai ka na hawmsak ding," ana chi zel hi.
english: Absalom said moreover, “Oh that I were made judge in the land, that every man who has any suit or cause might come to me, and I would do him justice!”

paite: Hichi leng ahi lai a, kuapeuh amah zahtakna pe dia hong paitou peuhmah akhut a sawk in alen a, ana tawp hi.
english: It was so, that when any man came near to bow down to him, he stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and kissed him.

paite: Israel mi kumpipa kiang a thugen dia hong kuan peuhmahte Absalom in huchibang in ana hih zel hi. Huchi in Absalom in Israel mite lungtang aguksak hi.
english: Absalom did this sort of thing to all Israel who came to the king for judgment. So Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, kum li ahong bei in Absalom in kumpipa kiang ah, Hebron a TOUPA kiang a ka thuchiam tangtun ding in hon hohsak in.
english: At the end of forty years, Absalom said to the king, “Please let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed to Yahweh, in Hebron.

paite: "Na sikha in Siria gam a Geshur a ka om lai in Jerusalem a ahon pikik peuhmahleh TOUPA nna ka sem ding, chi in thu ka chiam khinta ngal a," achi hi.
english: For your servant vowed a vow while I stayed at Geshur in Syria, saying, ‘If Yahweh shall indeed bring me again to Jerusalem, then I will serve Yahweh.’”

paite: Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Khamuangtak in kuan in," achi hi. Huchi in athou a, Hebron ah ahohta hi.
english: The king said to him, “Go in peace.” So he arose and went to Hebron.

paite: Himahleh Absalom in, “Pengkul ging na zak peuhmah chiang un, Hebron ah Absalom kumpipa ahita, na chi ding uh," chi in Israel nam tengteng kiang ah mi asimsawl khinta hi.
english: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, “As soon as you hear the sound of the trumpet, then you shall say, ‘Absalom is king in Hebron!’”

paite: Jerusalem a pan asap mi zanih in Absalom azui uhi. Amau bel lungsim siangtak pu in ahoh ua, thil omdan bangmah athei kei uh.
english: Two hundred men went with Absalom out of Jerusalem, who were invited, and went in their simplicity; and they didn’t know anything.

paite: Absalom in kithoihnate alat lai in Gilon mi Ahithophel, David thudotmi, Giloh a pan athukhak hi. Athusawmguk uh athupi mahmah a; Absalom lam ah lah mipite apung hulhul uhi.
english: Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David’s counselor, from his city, even from Giloh, while he was offering the sacrifices. The conspiracy was strong, for the people increased continually with Absalom.

paite: David kiang ah, Israel mite lungtang Absalom lam ah a-awn mahmah, chih thupotu khat in ahong hilh hi.
heading: Jerusalem A Pan David Ataikhia
english: A messenger came to David, saying, “The hearts of the men of Israel are after Absalom.”

paite: David in Jerusalem a om, asikha tengteng kiang ah, "Thou unla i taikhe ding uh. Kuamah lah Absalom a pan suakta lou ding i hi ngal ua. Pawtkhe meng un. Huchi lou in zaw ahon pha pah mai dia, i tung uah thil hoih loutak ahon tun dia, namsau in khua ahong sual kha ding," achi hi.
english: David said to all his servants who were with him at Jerusalem, “Arise! Let’s flee, or else none of us will escape from Absalom. Hurry to depart, lest he overtake us quickly and bring down evil on us, and strike the city with the edge of the sword.”

paite: Kumpipa sikhate'n kumpipa kiang ah, "Ngai in, na sikhate ka toupa, ka kumpipa un aseh peuhmah hih dia mansa ka hi gige uh," achi uhi.
english: The king’s servants said to the king, “Behold, your servants are ready to do whatever my lord the king chooses.”

paite: Kumpipa apawt a, a-inkote tengteng in azui uhi. Kumpipa'n inn ngak ding in numei sawm, ameite akoih hi.
english: The king went out, and all his household after him. The king left ten women, who were concubines, to keep the house.

paite: Kumpipa apawt a, mi tengteng in azui uh. Gamla kuam mun khat, inn tawpna ah akhawl tadih uhi.
english: The king went out, and all the people after him; and they stayed in Beth Merhak.

paite: Asikha tengteng in apaikheng ua; Kerit mite, Pelet mite, Git mite, mi zaguk Gath a pan amah hon zuite kumpipa ma ah apai uhi.
english: All his servants passed on beside him; and all the Cherethites, and all the Pelethites, and all the Gittites, six hundred men who came after him from Gath, passed on before the king.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n Git mi, Ittai kiang ah, "Bangchidan ahia nang na hong tel? Paikik nawn inla, kumpipa kiang ah om in. Nang zaw mikhual gamdangmi leng na hi ngal a, nangmah mun lam ah kik nawn mai in.
english: Then the king said to Ittai the Gittite, “Why do you also go with us? Return, and stay with the king; for you are a foreigner and also an exile. Return to your own place.

paite: Zan zek a hong na hi a, tuni a ka kiang ua asuk atou a hon zui sam ding in ka hon chi ding maw? Ka pai theihtheihna a pai ding ka hi, nang zaw kik nawn inla, na unaute tengteng pikik nawn in. Hehpihna leh thutak na kiang ah om hen," achi hi.
english: Whereas you came but yesterday, should I today make you go up and down with us, since I go where I may? Return, and take back your brothers. Mercy and truth be with you.”

paite: Ittai in kumpipa kiang ah, "TOUPA hinna leh kumpipa, ka toupa ahin bang in ka gen ahi. Kumpipa, ka toupa na omna peuh ah, sih leh sih, dam leh dam, na sikha a-om sam ding," achi hi.
english: Ittai answered the king and said, “As Yahweh lives, and as my lord the king lives, surely in what place my lord the king is, whether for death or for life, your servant will be there also.”

paite: David in Ittai kiang ah, "Pai inla, va galkai in," achi hi. Huchi in Git mi Ittai, amite tengteng leh ataneute tengteng toh agalkai uhi.
english: David said to Ittai, “Go and pass over.” Ittai the Gittite passed over, and all his men, and all the little ones who were with him.

paite: Ngaihtak in huai gammi teng akap ua, mipite apai vek uhi. Gamdai lampi zuan in apai ua, kumpipa'n leng Kidron lui akan a, mipi tengteng in leng akan uhi.
english: All the country wept with a loud voice, and all the people passed over. The king also himself passed over the brook Kidron, and all the people passed over toward the way of the wilderness.

paite: Huan ngai in, Pathian thukhun bawm zawng in Zadok leh Levite tengteng akiang ah ahong pai uhi. Pathian bawm anga ua, mipi in khua apawtkhiaksan vek tan in Abiathar ahohtou hi.
english: Behold, Zadok also came, and all the Levites with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of God; and they set down God’s ark; and Abiathar went up until all the people finished passing out of the city.

paite: Kumpipa'n Zadok kiang ah, "Pathian bawm pen khopi sung ah zawnglut nawn un. TOUPA mitmuh a deihsakna ka tanleh ahon pikik nawn dia, Pathian bawm leh a-omna ahon musak nawn ding.
english: The king said to Zadok, “Carry God’s ark back into the city. If I find favor in Yahweh’s eyes, he will bring me again, and show me both it and his habitation;

paite: Himahleh, nang ah kipahna mahmah ka nei kei achihleh, ngai in, hichi mai ka hi a, hoih asak bangbang in ka tung ah hih mai hen," achi hi.
english: but if he says, ‘I have no delight in you,’ behold, here I am. Let him do to me as seems good to him.”

paite: Kumpipa'n siampu Zadok kiang ah, "Mutheipa na hi kei a hia? Na tapate nih, na tapa Ahimaaz leh Abiathar tapa Jonathan toh lungmuangtak in khopi ah pai nawn un.
english: The king said also to Zadok the priest, “Aren’t you a seer? Return into the city in peace, and your two sons with you, Ahimaaz your son and Jonathan the son of Abiathar.

paite: Ngai in, kei zaw tanchin ahong theihsak masiah uh gamdai a lui kannate ah ka na om ding,” achi hi.
english: Behold, I will stay at the fords of the wilderness until word comes from you to inform me.”

paite: Zadok leh Abiathar in Jerusalem ah Pathian bawm apaipih nawn ua; huai ah a-omta uh.
english: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried God’s ark to Jerusalem again; and they stayed there.

paite: Olive tang paitouhna ah David akahtou a, apaitouh ka kawm in akap kawmkawm hi. Alu akhuh a, khevuak in apai hi. Akiang a mi om tengteng in alu uh akhuh chiat ua, kap kawmkawm in apaitou uhi.
english: David went up by the ascent of the Mount of Olives, and wept as he went up; and he had his head covered and went barefoot. All the people who were with him each covered his head, and they went up, weeping as they went up.

paite: Kuahiam khat in Ahithophel, Absalom lam a pang in thusawm mite lak ah apang sam, chih David ahilh hi. David in, "TOUPA aw, Ahithophel lemtheihna haina suaksak ding in ka hon ngen hi," achi hi.
english: Someone told David, saying, “Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom.” David said, “Yahweh, please turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Pathian biakna tang vum a David akahkhiak touhleh, ngai in, Arki mi Hushai apuanak bohkek silh a, alu a lei kai niaunuau in amah dawn ding in ahong pai hi.
english: When David had come to the top, where God was worshiped, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his tunic torn and earth on his head.

paite: David in akiang ah, "Ka kiang a na hong samleh zaw, kei a ding in puakgik na hi ding.
english: David said to him, “If you pass on with me, then you will be a burden to me;

paite: Himahleh khopi a na kik nawn a, Absalom kiang a, toupa aw, na sikha in ka om ding. Tuma lam a na pa sikha a ka om bang in, tu in na sikha in ka om leuleu ding, na va chihleh Ahithophel lemtheihna hon dalsakpa na hi zaw ding hi.
english: but if you return to the city, and tell Absalom, ‘I will be your servant, O king. As I have been your father’s servant in time past, so I will now be your servant; then you will defeat for me the counsel of Ahithophel.’

paite: Huai ah na kiang ah siampu Zadok leh Abiathar leng a-om sam uh ahi kei maw? Huan hichi ahi ding a, kumpipa' inn a thupawt na zak peuhmah siampu Zadok leh Abiathar na hilh zel ding.
english: Don’t you have Zadok and Abiathar the priests there with you? Therefore whatever you hear out of the king’s house, tell it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests.

paite: Ngai in, atapate uh nih Zadok tapa Ahimaaz leh Abiathar tapa Jonathan leng akiang uah a-om uhi. Na thil zak peuhmahte hon theisak ding in amau na hon sawl zel ding," achi hi.
english: Behold, they have there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz, Zadok’s son, and Jonathan, Abiathar’s son. Send to me everything that you shall hear by them.”

paite: Huchi in David lawm, Hushai khopi ah alut a; huchi in Jerusalem ah Absalom alutta hi.
english: So Hushai, David’s friend, came into the city; and Absalom came into Jerusalem.
